$comment: Text pool for the Life Transitions prayer category.
requests: Retiring in two weeks after 35 years. Pray for this next chapter.
Our youngest leaves for college Saturday. Pray for my heart.
New baby due any day now! Pray for a safe delivery.
Moving to Tucson next month. Pray we find a good church.
We are moving across the country to North Carolina for my husband's job. The kids are sad to leave their friends. Pray for a smooth move and quick new friendships for them.
Our daughter just left for her freshman year in Oregon. The house is so quiet. Pray for her to find good friends and a church, and for me as I adjust.
Starting a new job on Monday after 12 years at my last one. I am excited and nervous. Pray I learn quickly and fit in with my new team.
We moved my mom into assisted living this week. It was the right decision, but it was hard. Pray for her to settle in and feel at home.
Lord, thank you for 30 years of work. Now help me figure out who I am without it. Retirement is harder than I expected.
Empty nest at last, and my husband and I are learning how to be just the two of us again. Pray for this new season of our marriage.
My son graduates from high school next week and still does not know what he wants to do. Pray for clear direction and for him to trust God with his future.
We just welcomed our second baby. Our toddler is not so sure about it. Pray for rest, patience, and a gentle transition for our big girl.
A friend from church is moving away after 15 years here. It is a good move for her family, but we will miss her. Pray for her new start in Kansas.
Closing on our first home next week. It has been a long road. Pray for the last steps to go smoothly and for this house to be a place of peace.
My dad is retiring from the fire department this month. He has served for 28 years. Pray for him to find purpose and joy in what comes next.
Graduating from nursing school in May! Pray for me as I take my licensing exam and look for my first job.
Our family is downsizing to a smaller home. Sorting through 25 years of memories is harder than I thought. Pray for wisdom on what to keep and peace in letting go.
Pray for my coworker who is about to become a first-time dad. He is excited and a little terrified. Pray for a healthy baby and a strong start for their family.
We are moving my in-laws from Illinois to Phoenix to be close to us. They are leaving everything they know. Pray they find community and feel at home here.
Just got married and moved to a new city where I do not know anyone. Pray for friendships and for a church family to connect with.
After years of working nights, I finally have a day shift. It is a good change but my body and my family are still adjusting. Pray for rhythm and rest.

This fall brings a lot of change for our family all at once. Our oldest is starting college out of state, our middle child is starting high school, and I am going back to work full time for the first time in 16 years. I am grateful, but it feels like everything is shifting under my feet. Pray for each of us to find our footing, and for our home to stay a place of rest.

My mom has lived in the same house in Scottsdale for 40 years, and this month we are moving her into assisted living. She agreed it is time, but she cries every time she packs a box. I am trying to be patient and help her honor her memories without carrying everything with her. Pray for her heart, for the staff who will care for her, and for us kids as this chapter closes.

I retired last month after a long career, and I thought I would love every minute. Instead, I feel a bit lost. I miss the people, the routine, and feeling useful. My wife has been patient with me hanging around the house. Pray that I would find meaningful ways to serve, including here at church, and that I would see this as a new beginning instead of an ending.

We found out we are expecting our third child, which was a surprise for us. We are thankful, but also a little overwhelmed thinking about space, money, and sleep. My wife is having a hard first trimester. Pray for a healthy pregnancy, for her strength, and for our two kids to be excited about a new sibling. Most of all, pray that we trust God with all the unknowns.
details: Change is hard, even when it is good. We are trying to hold it loosely.
Pray for our whole family as we adjust to a new normal.
I know God goes before us. I just need help remembering that on the hard days.
There are a lot of emotions in this season, happy and sad mixed together.
Pray for patience with ourselves and each other while things settle.
We are excited, and we are also tired. Both are true right now.
"For everything there is a season" (Ecclesiastes 3:1, WEB). This verse has been on my mind a lot.
We would love wisdom about the next steps, and peace about the ones we cannot see yet.
Thank you for praying. It helps to know our church family is behind us.
Pray for new friendships and a sense of belonging in this next chapter.
answers: We are settling in well. Thank you for praying us through the change.
The transition was smoother than we feared. God was so kind.
Still adjusting, but every week feels a little more normal.
Not everything is settled, but we are at peace. Thank you, church family.
God has been faithful in every step of this. We are grateful.
Some days are still hard, but we are finding our way. Keep praying with us.
Praise God! This new chapter is off to a good start.
We are still in the middle of it, but we feel your prayers.
It has been a good change, even with the bumps. Thank you for caring.
Things are coming together slowly. We see God's hand in it.
